triples.head_surface: pump casing has been filled with liquid
triples.tail_surface: self-priming centrifugal pump will not function
triples.evidence_text: A self-priming centrifugal pump will not function until the pump casing has been filled with liquid.
Furthermore, the pump must never run dry.

triples.head_surface: operate against closed discharge valve for a short time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80°C for standard pumps)
triples.head_canonical_zh: 关闭排出阀运行超时或超温
triples.tail_surface: risk of damage to the pump and, at worst, of a steam explosion
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵损坏及蒸汽爆炸风险
triples.evidence_text: For safety reasons the pump is only allowed to operate against closed discharge valve for a short time (max. 5 minutes and at a max. temperature of 80°C for standard pumps). Otherwise there is a risk of damage to the pump and, at worst, of a steam explosion.

triples.head_surface: considerably smaller delivery head than expected
triples.evidence_text: A considerably smaller delivery head than expected will increase the quantity of liquid delivered, causing increased power consumption and perhaps cavitation in pump and piping.

triples.tail_surface: impeller may show signs of heavy erosion
triples.evidence_text: In the pump the impeller may show signs of heavy erosion caused by cavitation (corrosion) which may at times render an impeller unfit for use in a very short time.

triples.head_surface: measuring the current intensity of the connected motor
triples.evidence_text: Therefore, after start-up, it is necessary to check either the quantity of liquid delivered or the power consumption of the pump e.g. by measuring the current intensity of the connected motor.
